about: VRAM watchdog settings. Values marked 'design' come from docs/studio-design.md (Tool layer, ComfyUI restart procedure) as proposed defaults; tune them from the VRAM log.

sources.progress_timeout_s: design: no progress for 5 min while a job runs (about five steps at 45-70 s each)
sources.api_timeout_s: design: no API answer for 2 min
sources.start_timeout_s: design: alert after 3 min without an API answer
sources.max_restarts_per_window: design: two restarts per window; a third halt ends the window
sources.startup_timeout_s: added in Phase 1 step 7: before a job's first sampler step there is no progress line (model load, text encode)
sources.released_max_used_gb: added in Phase 1 step 7: Windows reports no per-process VRAM, so 'memory released' means total used falls below this; idle desktop use was 3.6 GB on 2026-10-09
sources.headroom_margin_gb: added in Phase 1 step 7: safety margin on top of a configuration's recorded peak
sources.unmeasured_required_gb: added in Phase 1 step 7: required free VRAM for a configuration with no recorded peak yet (nearly the whole 32 GB card); replaced by the measured peak after the first run
